description: Patient name missing -> hold order, request name
Patient sex missing -> hold order, request sex
Anatomic site on blacklist (definitively out-of-scope) -> DO_NOT_PROCESS
Specimen type incompatible with histology workflow -> DO_NOT_PROCESS
HER2 ordered and fixative is not formalin -> DO_NOT_PROCESS
HER2 ordered and fixation time outside 6-72h -> DO_NOT_PROCESS
Billing info missing -> MISSING_INFO_PROCEED with flag
All accessioning validations pass -> ACCEPTED (defined as: no other ACC rule fires)
HER2 ordered and fixation time is null -> MISSING_INFO_HOLD
Specimen type unrecognized (not whitelist or blacklist) -> PENDING_LLM_REVIEW
Anatomic site in LLM-review band (not whitelist or blacklist) -> PENDING_LLM_REVIEW
Anatomic site null -> MISSING_INFO_HOLD
Sample-prep step completed successfully -> advance
Sample-prep step failed, tissue available -> RETRY current
Sample-prep step failed, insufficient tissue -> ABORT (QNS)
Sample-prep QC passes -> advance to HE_STAINING
Sample-prep QC fails, tissue available -> RETRY (back to SECTIONING)
Sample-prep QC fails, insufficient tissue -> ABORT (QNS)
Sectioning completes with RECUT_REQUESTED set -> clear flag and advance to SAMPLE_PREP_QC
H&E QC passes -> route to PATHOLOGIST_HE_REVIEW
H&E QC fails, restain possible -> RETRY (back to HE_STAINING)
H&E QC fails, recut needed, tissue available -> RETRY (back to SECTIONING)
H&E QC fails, insufficient tissue -> ABORT (QNS)
Pathologist diagnosis: invasive carcinoma -> PROCEED_IHC (ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67)
Pathologist diagnosis: DCIS -> PROCEED_IHC (ER, PR; HER2 only if originally ordered)
Pathologist diagnosis: suspicious/atypical -> PROCEED_IHC (custom panel)
Pathologist diagnosis: benign -> CANCEL_IHC, route to RESULTING
Pathologist requests recuts -> REQUEST_RECUTS (back to SECTIONING)
HER2 added by pathologist + fixation out of tolerance -> reject HER2 (set HER2_FIXATION_REJECT) (fires on ihc_staining_complete)
All slides stained, IHC QC passed -> route to IHC_SCORING
Some IHC slides still pending -> HOLD at IHC_QC
IHC staining failed, retry possible -> RETRY staining
IHC staining failed, insufficient tissue -> ABORT (QNS)
IHC scoring complete, no equivocal results -> route to RESULTING
HER2 equivocal -> SUGGEST_FISH_REFLEX (set FISH_SUGGESTED)
Pathologist approves FISH reflex -> FISH_SEND_OUT
Pathologist declines FISH reflex -> route to RESULTING
FISH result received from external lab -> route to RESULTING
FISH external lab returns QNS -> ABORT (QNS)
MISSING_INFO_PROCEED flag present on order -> RESULTING_HOLD
Missing info received, re-evaluate flags -> proceed or remain on hold
All scoring/testing complete, no blocking flags -> PATHOLOGIST_SIGNOUT
Pathologist selects reportable tests -> REPORT_GENERATION
Report generated -> ORDER_COMPLETE
